_comment: Statuses: live-per-site = on the live site AND backed by code; live = confirmed by Sumit; in-code = backend implements it, production not confirmed; not-live = Sumit says it is not available to users today; no-evidence = claimed on the site, no backend support found. Only live and live-per-site may be claimed in copy. Flip a status to 'live' to publish gated pages.

membership_lifecycle.evidence: members/*, renew, suspend, freeze, gift-days routes

gst_tax_lines.evidence: GymTax, InvoiceTax models; tax_views.py; company_gst field (models.py:122). Not verified: CGST/SGST vs IGST split, GSTIN on invoice, HSN/SAC

biometric_adms.evidence: biometric_adms_views.py, biometric_owner_views.py. Mentioned in passing on /pricing and home FAQ; needs confirmation. Device models unknown.

workout_diet_plans.evidence: Plan builders exist in code, but Sumit says workout and diet plans are not available to users. Do not mention workout plans or diet plans.

plan_requests_approval.evidence: Depends on workout and diet plans, which are not live.

whatsapp_sms_push_alerts.evidence: auth_core/notifications/*; notify_* commands. Provider Fast2SMS WhatsApp: do not say 'WhatsApp Business API' until confirmed

ecommerce_cart_orders.evidence: cart_views.py, order_views.py, product_views.py exist, but Sumit says the store is not available to users. Do not mention online store, products, cart or orders.

branded_android_member_app.evidence: dashboard_views.py, whitelabel_views.py. How per-gym branding works in the app is unverified

public_gym_profile_api.evidence: PublicGymProfileView (JSON only, marketing_views.py). No consent flag or HTML pages yet

self_serve_signup_subscription.evidence: auth/org/register, owner/plans, owner/subscribe. Site says 'we build your account' and 'custom quote'

class_scheduling_booking.evidence: No booking/enrolment routes. Only batches + opening hours

staff_salary_attendance_hr.evidence: No staff attendance or salary models

gym_faqs_text_video.evidence: FAQ model is platform-level, super-admin only

report_export_excel_pdf.evidence: No export endpoints found; dashboard may export client-side. Ask Sumit

due_payment_reminders.evidence: notify_due_payments command exists, but the job is not scheduled in production (25 Sep audit). NO page may claim automated due-payment reminders.

whatsapp_expiry_reminders.evidence: send_membership_alerts: WhatsApp 7, 3 and 1 days before expiry plus the day after, to members. Live only after Sumit confirms the schedule is running.

whatsapp_birthday_messages.evidence: notify_member_birthdays. Live only after Sumit confirms the schedule is running.
